integrity.computational_reproducibility: Run python3 CHECK.py. Exact arithmetic; no external input.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact exhaustive finite face, lattice-index and incidence checks combined with standard toric orbit-cone theorems; standalone standard-library checker supplied.
integrity.source_provenance: ArXiv version first publicly available 2016-03-06; later journal publication in 2019.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the normal-fan toric fivefold of the five-cycle stable-set polytope. The statement classifies the reduced singular locus, generic transverse types and pairwise incidence; it does not determine the full singular scheme or analytic germs at all intersections. A separately indexed, equivalent prior local classification cannot be excluded completely.
title: Ten conifold planes in the pentagon stable-set toric fivefold
